name: zclass_render_dispatch
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeRenderDispatch applies the variant gate and dispatches render traversal by node class id.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for the render dispatch cycle; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass render traversal source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44c0e0 validates the nodeType variant gate, classId-1 jump table, class-specific render traversal calls, and unrecognized-class fprintf fallback.

The native render traversal dispatch smoke verifies variant rejection, object dispatch recursion, and dispatch through representative camera, light, sound, animate, LOD, sequence, and switch traversal paths.
